claims.text: On Python 3.14, ProxySchemeUnknown ends up with URLSchemeUnknown's prefix in front of its own message.
The expected message (and what Python 3.13 prints) is `Proxy URL had unsupported scheme ftp, should use http:// or https://`.
On Python 3.14, err.scheme is set to that whole message rather than `"ftp"`.
On Python 3.13 and older, err.scheme does not exist at all.

After the fix, ProxySchemeUnknown.__init__ calls LocationValueError.__init__ directly, making the result independent of Python version and setting self.scheme appropriately (None for the no-scheme and localhost cases).
On Python 3.13 the same test fails with an AttributeError because ProxySchemeUnknown has no scheme attribute.
After applying the fix, the test passes on both Python 3.13 and 3.14.
After the fix, the full test suite passes on Python 3.13 and 3.14 and nox -s lint is clean.
